description: This PHP source file manages the WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) configuration and interface for wireless network setup in a web-based router or gateway admin panel. It includes PHP backend logic, external includes, and embedded JavaScript for client-side interaction.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the WPS PIN checksum to ensure correctness before attempting configuration.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to configure WPS settings such as enable/disable, PIN, or pairing actions.
